## Checklist

- [ ] Targets the open version branch (contributors) or bumps `version.txt` with a `CHANGELOG.md` entry (maintainer release PRs to `main`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated in `tests/run_tests.sh` for new behavior
- [ ] Test suite passes (`tests/vm.sh test ubuntu`, and `fedora` for distro-specific changes)
- [ ] `README.md` and `--help`/`--about` updated for new or changed options
